title: Marked model structures for ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric operads
statement: Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Use the ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Use model categories, weak equivalences, cofibrations, fibrations, and Quillen adjunctions as in [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction]. A marked simplicial set is a simplicial set with a collection of marked edges containing every degenerate edge. Let $I$ be the inert arrows of $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$, opposite to inclusions of consecutive subintervals. On marked simplicial sets over $(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}},I)$ there are ordinary and generalized operadic model structures. Both have monomorphisms as cofibrations, hence every object is cofibrant; their fibrant objects are respectively ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads with precisely their inert cocartesian arrows marked. Their associated infinity categories are the corresponding infinity categories of operads and inert-preserving functors. The identity adjunction from the generalized structure to the ordinary structure is left Quillen. Both structures are enriched, tensored, and cotensored over the categorical model structure on marked simplicial sets; the identity adjunction respects this enrichment. Here categorical weak equivalence means equivalence of the represented infinity categories. For a cofibration $i:A\to B$ and a fibrant target $P$, enriched restriction $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(B,P)\to\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(A,P)$ is a fibration and is a categorical weak equivalence if $i$ is a trivial cofibration. For generalized fibrant operads $M,P$ (including an ordinary fibrant target $P$), the represented enriched Hom infinity category is the full infinity category $\operatorname{Alg}_M(P)$ of inert-preserving functors and coherent transformations, rather than merely its core.
